（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

C. I. D.
I. O. REC
13.
No 121/16
Date 1/1/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

January 12th 1915.

Sir,
It is reported that the City gentry held a private meeting at 2 p.m. 11th instant when ways and means of inducing the Chinese Authorities to remove the Arsenal was discussed.
Since the explosion on the S.N.R. line the guard on the line between Shanghai and Tsung Z had been reinforced with thirty six additional troops.
The Military Governor and the Shanghai Taoyin have each received a telegram from the Central Government saying it has come to the knowledge of the Peking Authorities that the Chinese newspapers in Shanghai have failed to comply with the order regarding the change in the calendar and giving instructions that newspapers that adhere to the republican calendar are not to be allowed to pass through the post.
A report resembling a bomb explosion was heard in the City at 4 p.m. yesterday. The origin of the noise which frightened the residents very much cannot be traced.
There are two brigand societies in Pootung which are called Lung Sau Wei 龍精會 and Bah Loong Wo 百龍會. Each society has about 3,000 members who are all enrolled as rebels.

（批：Entered on
MS Jan 12
Seen by C.S.）

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmmmuclong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处）

警务处，
（侦探股。）

刑事侦缉处
情报官收件
13.
编号 121/16
日期 1916年1月1日

致上海工部局。

1915年1月12日。

先生：

据报，本城士绅于本月11日下午2时举行秘密会议，商讨促使中国当局迁走兵工厂之方法。

自沪宁铁路发生爆炸事件以来，上海至宗泽（Tsung Z，音译）之间的铁路沿线警卫已增派三十六名士兵。

护军使与上海道台均收到中央政府发来的电报，称北京当局获悉上海各中文报纸未遵行关于更改历法的命令，并指示不得允许刊登共和历（即民国历）的报纸通过邮政系统寄递。

昨日下午4时，城内听到一声类似炸弹爆炸的巨响。此声响令居民极为惊恐，但其来源无法查明。

浦东有两个匪帮社团，分别称为“龙精会”和“百龙会”。每个社团约有成员三千人，均登记为反叛分子。

（批注：录入于
1月12日手稿
总巡阅毕）

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmmmuclong
首席侦探督察长。

致警察总监上尉
